data.name: Ethelinda
data.long_meaning: From the Greek 'aethere' (eternal) and 'lindos' (struggle). This name embodies the idea of a woman who faces challenges with unwavering determination and perseverance.

data.cultural_impact: Ethelinda is a name rooted in Greek mythology, carrying the implication of a divine and eternal nature. It hails from a rich cultural tradition, inspiring those who bear the name with a sense of strength, resilience, and enduring spirit.

She models the virtues of perseverance, courage, and fortitude in the face of adversity, embodying the indomitable spirit of a woman of God.
